for picking this up. Passing `auth` through to both transports looks like the right fix for #1723, and I like that `exclude=True` keeps the handler out of `model_dump()`. I read it against current `main` and ran into a few things. 1. This needs a rebase. #3600 added `max_sse_event_size` to `StreamableHttpParameters` in the same spot where this PR adds `auth`, so the branch conflicts in `session_group.py`. When you rebase, check that `max_sse_event_size` still gets forwarded to `streamable_http_client` and that the parametrized test still asserts it. 2. What happens when someone sets both `headers={"Authorization": ...}` and `auth=`? httpx runs the auth flow after it merges the client headers, and `OAuthClientProvider._add_auth_header` in `src/mcp/client/auth/oauth2.py` overwrites `Authorization` whenever it has a token. So the manual header goes out until the provider gets a token, and after that it's silently replaced. `test_session_group_headers_and_auth_coexistence` sets `"Authorization": "Bearer manual"` but only checks `X-Trace-Id`, and the docs say custom headers "can still be supplied alongside `auth`". I'd either drop `Authorization` from that test, or assert which one wins and say so in the docs. 3. The docs example can't run as written. The rest of `session-groups.md` pulls examples in with `--8<--` from `docs_src/session_groups/`, and `tests/docs_src/test_session_groups.py` exercises them. This block uses `client_metadata`, `token_storage`, `redirect_handler` and `callback_handler` without defining any of them. Moving it to `docs_src/session_groups/tutorial005.py` would match the rest of the page and put it under test. The setup in `docs_src/oauth_clients/` could probably be reused. 4. Small nit: `test_establish_session_sse_passes_auth` and `test_establish_session_streamable_http_passes_auth` check the same thing as the two assertions you added to `test_client_session_group_establish_session_parameterized`. If you add an `auth=` case to that test's parametrize list, you'd cover both transports with much less mock setup. The approach itself looks fine to me.
